title: Core: AS2 getter/setter via addProperty
description: Test compilation of the ActionScript 2 addProperty() pattern: this.addProperty('name', getter, setter), MyClass.prototype.addProperty('x', getX, setX). Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) with 'addProperty' string. Also test Object.addProperty(obj, 'prop', getter, setter). Verify getter and setter are function references (ActionDefineFunction2 0x8E or ActionGetVariable 0x1c).
